summary: S04T02 updated generated skill adapter contracts for agent directives. Source skills now require inspecting agentDirectives, handling required/blocking directives, reporting conflicts/deprecations/missingRequired IDs, and treating runtime fields as typed data. Workflow asset validation now rejects source or installed skills missing those markers, and Codex/Claude installed skill checks plus tests cover the contract.
command: marker coverage across skills; git diff --cached --check; bwrk docs check --json; bwrk doctor skills --skill-target codex --skill-target claude --json; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/workflow-docs.test.ts; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/cli.test.ts -t 'installs Codex and Claude skill files and keeps dry-run read-only|reports stale or target-mismatched installed skills|lists workflows, shows workflow markdown, plans skill installs, and doctors skill assets'; bwrk sync refresh --json; bwrk doctor --strict --json
